name: Fourbital Factory
old_description: Whether you're ordering branded merchandise, launching a retail collection, or testing a new product idea, Fourbital Factory offers flexible manufacturing programs designed around your goals.
about:
Fourbital Factory operates from Burlington, Vermont, where it designs and produces custom beanies entirely in-house. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a Vermont-based manufacturer focused on domestic production.

The factory specializes in custom knit beanies, offering private-label, small-batch, and scaled production programs. Capabilities include 1×1 and 3×1 rib, chunky rib, and custom jacquard knitting in acrylic or merino wool, with over 40 acrylic and 15 wool color options. Finishing services cover embroidered patches, woven labels, pom-poms, and custom packaging. The vertically integrated workflow moves from design through prototyping (about one week) to full production (three to five weeks) and shipping (three to seven business days), with minimums as low as 25 units.

Fourbital serves a broad range of clients, including apparel and outdoor brands, retail collections, subscription boxes, ski resorts, breweries, universities, nonprofits, hospitality groups, sports teams, and corporate merchandise programs. A noted case study highlights a partnership with Darn Tough, transforming leftover sock yarn into wool beanies. The company also supports emerging brands, Kickstarter campaigns, and seasonal collaborations through its low-minimum model.

The company emphasizes quality, flexibility, and true partnership, positioning its domestic, small-batch approach as an alternative to overseas production. By keeping manufacturing local, Fourbital aims to move quickly, communicate clearly, and deliver craftsmanship that sets clients’ products apart, while supporting local jobs and offering “100% tariff-proof” production.
